name: The Great Cat Spirit
summary: A wise spirit in southern Moonglade teaches druids who seek the cat shape. You go to learn what it knows of the feline form.

sections.title: A Druid's Teacher
sections.body: Druids who seek the feline shape look to the Great Cat Spirit in southern Moonglade. It lives on a hill overlooking the bridge, where it offers wisdom to those who come to learn. You seek its teaching about the nature of the cat.

faq.q: Where is the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit lives on a hill in southern Moonglade overlooking the bridge.

faq.q: What does the Great Cat Spirit teach?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit teaches druids about the nature of the cat and the feline shape.

faq.q: Why do druids seek the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: Druids who desire the feline shape seek the Great Cat Spirit's wisdom and instruction.

angles.text: As a druid, you seek the Great Cat Spirit's wisdom if you desire to take the feline shape.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Cat Spirit
